name: Avidich
description: Avidich was a terrestrial planet of the Chiss Ascendancy, located in the Unknown Regions. After a majority of the population of the Chiss capital of Csilla were forced offworld by changes in the planet's climate, Avidich was one of the planets they were sent to.
